english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese noun for a brief or cursory look.
Use 一眼 as the all-purpose everyday noun for a brief, incomplete look.
Use 一眼 for a glance or a brief attempt to see something; it is the all-purpose noun for this sense.

examples.english: I could see a cat under the table at a glance.
examples.traditional: 我一眼就睇到張枱底有隻貓。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dou2 zoeng1 toi2 dai2 jau5 zek3 maau1

examples.english: I only got a glimpse of the photo.

examples.english: I want to have a look at the document first.
